description: This header file declares the exported API functions for the Slap Bmc2 Input Object, part of the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) in the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It provides prototypes for creation, retrieval, and management functions related to the BMC2 input object.

methods.name: SlapCreateBmc2Input
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new BMC2 Input object with given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoGetSlapObjCallMap
methods.description: Retrieves the call map object for the BMC2 Input.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoGetSlapObjDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor object for the BMC2 Input.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the BMC2 Input object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the BMC2 Input object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary sub-objects or components within the BMC2 Input.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the BMC2 Input object after creation.
